desc: Ideation: reduce to shortest-common-supersequence of the red/blue chains; answer = Dr + Db − LCS, with −1 when a ball sits off X's cycle.
Implement the full solution (fast I/O, backward cycle distances from X, feasibility check, chain construction, strict-LIS LCS, output).

Validation: samples verified by hand-trace of the actual code path (S1 → 3+2−1=4, S2 → 0 via the Dr=Db=0 shortcut, S3 → red at box 1 off X's P-cycle → −1, S4 → 3+7−2=8); lower-bound (every valid word contains both chains as subsequences, even if X is operated) and sufficiency (invariant: after the Rchain occurrence of nodeAtDistP[k], all red balls are at distance ≤ k−1; distances never increase since X is never operated; blue symmetric and independent) both re-checked, so Dr+Db−LCS is exactly optimal.
